name: CtrlS Patna Edge DC 1
notes: CtrlS official Patna page lists the Patna Edge DC 1 facility with 109 racks and 0.50 MW IT load, carrier neutral; CtrlS executives confirmed edge datacentre operations are live in Patna (one of CtrlS's tier-2 edge locations alongside Lucknow). Capacity and existence from official company page.

name: CtrlS Patna Edge DC 2 (Patliputra Industrial Area)
notes: CtrlS acquired land in the Patliputra Industrial Area (via BIADA) in Aug 2024 for a Rs 400 crore greenfield edge data centre with about 10 MW IT load and ~1,000 racks; the CtrlS official page now lists Patna Edge DC 2 at 11.6 MW IT load / 1,670 racks. Status marked planned as construction completion is not confirmed by public sources.

name: Bihar State Data Centre 2.0 (BSDC 2.0)
developer: Department of Information Technology, Government of Bihar
notes: Uptime Institute lists the certified Bihar State Data Centre 2.0 in Patna for the Department of Information Technology, Government of Bihar; the BSDC 2.0 building in Patna is completed per Aakriti Architects. It succeeds the original NeGP-era Bihar State Data Centre that hosts state e-governance workloads (NIC/BELTRON supported). No public MW capacity or commissioning year disclosed.
